breach.summary: Aflac disclosed a massive data breach affecting 22.65 million customers and employees. Threat actors gained unauthorized access to personal, medical, and health insurance data including Social Security numbers, dates of birth, driver's license numbers, and detailed health insurance policy information. The breach was discovered through suspicious account activities and exposed sensitive PII that could be used for identity theft and fraud.

Figure Technologies, a blockchain lending platform, suffered a data breach affecting approximately 967,000 user records. The ShinyHunters threat group leaked 2.4GB of confidential data after successfully social engineering a Figure employee to gain network access. Exposed information includes customer names, dates of birth, email addresses, physical addresses, and phone numbers used for account verification and customer contact.

Video hosting platform Vimeo confirmed a data breach where ShinyHunters threat group accessed user and customer data. The group obtained proprietary information and is actively threatening to release stolen files unless Vimeo pays a substantial ransom. The breach potentially impacts millions of content creators and enterprise customers who rely on Vimeo for video hosting and management.

Frost Bank customers were targeted by the Everest ransomware gang, which listed the bank on its dark web leak site claiming to have exfiltrated sensitive customer data. Compromised information includes full Social Security numbers, Tax IDs, W-2/1099 tax forms, mortgage records, home equity loan documents, and health savings account details. The breach exposed highly sensitive financial and personal information of over 250,000 individuals.

The zero-day vulnerability CVE-2024-4577 in Progress MOVEit Transfer file transfer software was exploited for mass data exfiltration campaigns. The Clop ransomware gang leveraged this vulnerability to compromise thousands of organizations across financial services, healthcare, government, and manufacturing sectors, stealing billions of sensitive records including healthcare claims, financial documents, and government databases.

T-Mobile disclosed unauthorized access to customer data through an API vulnerability that exposed personal information for approximately 37 million customers and prospective customers. Attackers obtained names, dates of birth, email addresses, phone numbers, and partial Social Security numbers. The breach impacted T-Mobile's largest customer base and exposed sensitive identity verification data.

UnitedHealth Group subsidiary Change Healthcare suffered a devastating ransomware attack by the LockBit gang affecting over 100 million healthcare records. The attack disrupted medical claims processing, pharmacy operations, and patient care across the entire US healthcare system. Attackers exfiltrated sensitive healthcare data including patient identifiers, insurance information, medical histories, and financial records of patients, providers, and insurers.

A catastrophic breach of National Public Data exposed personal information for nearly every US adult (277 million people). Data including full names, physical addresses, phone numbers, email addresses, and partial Social Security numbers was compiled and sold on the dark web. This megabreach represented one of the largest US personal data exposures and provided threat actors with comprehensive identity theft and fraud capabilities.

FirstCare Health Plans exposed healthcare member data through an unsecured and publicly accessible database containing 1.2 million member records. The exposed information included full member names, unique member identification numbers, policy numbers, dates of birth, and sensitive health plan information. The misconfiguration remained accessible for extended period before discovery and remediation.

Facial recognition company Clearview AI suffered a security breach compromising law enforcement agency credentials and access to its database containing over 200 million facial images scraped from the internet. Unauthorized access granted threat actors the ability to query and identify individuals using facial recognition searches. The breach raised significant privacy concerns regarding misuse of biometric surveillance technology.

cve.summary: cPanel & WHM contains a critical authentication bypass vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to gain full administrative control of hosting servers. The flaw is actively exploited in the wild since February 2026. Attackers can access all hosted customer websites, databases, email accounts, and server configurations without any credentials, leading to complete compromise of shared hosting environments.

GitHub Enterprise Server is vulnerable to remote code execution via a git push injection flaw in the internal X-Stat protocol. Any authenticated user on a GitHub instance can execute arbitrary commands on backend servers with service account privileges. This enables attackers to steal repositories, steal organization secrets, compromise CI/CD pipelines, and pivot to internal networks.

FortiClient Enterprise Management Server contains an improper access control vulnerability allowing unauthenticated remote code execution. This zero-day vulnerability is actively exploited in real-world attacks. Attackers can execute arbitrary code and gain complete control of the Fortinet endpoint management infrastructure affecting thousands of enterprise organizations' endpoint security posture.

Windows IKE (Internet Key Exchange) Service contains a critical remote code execution vulnerability triggered by a double-free memory corruption flaw when processing specially crafted IKE v2 packets. Attackers can send malicious packets on ports UDP 500/4500 to trigger the vulnerability without authentication, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution on Windows servers and VPN endpoints.

Windows Shell contains a zero-click NTLM hash leak vulnerability that allows attackers to steal authentication hashes without user interaction. APT28 (Russia) is actively exploiting this flaw against Ukraine and European Union government and military targets to gain initial access and lateral movement privileges for espionage operations.

Cisco IOS XE software contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the web management interface allowing unauthenticated attackers to access the device and execute arbitrary code. This vulnerability affects thousands of Cisco routers and switches deployed globally. Remote attackers can gain complete control of network infrastructure affecting critical business operations.

JetBrains TeamCity CI/CD platform contains a pre-authentication remote code execution vulnerability in the server component. Attackers can exploit this flaw to execute arbitrary code, compromise build pipelines, inject malicious code into software builds, steal source code repositories, and deploy ransomware. This vulnerability has been widely exploited by cybercriminals and nation-states.

SonicWall Secure Mobile Access (SMA) 1000 appliances contain combined path traversal and remote code execution vulnerabilities in the administrative interface. Attackers can bypass authentication, access sensitive configuration files containing credentials, and execute arbitrary commands on the appliance. This enables attackers to compromise VPN access for remote employees and intercept encrypted traffic.

Apache OFBiz open-source e-commerce framework contains a Java deserialization remote code execution vulnerability. Attackers can send crafted requests to execute arbitrary Java code on the server. This vulnerability affects thousands of small to mid-size e-commerce businesses and has been actively exploited for mass compromise campaigns installing backdoors and ransomware.

Linux Kernel contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in the netfilter subsystem allowing unprivileged local users to escalate privileges to root. This flaw affects millions of Linux servers and enables attackers to gain complete system control. The vulnerability is trivial to exploit and has been weaponized in numerous Linux-based attacks.

threat.ttp: Zero-click exploits, PRISMEX malware, LNK chains
threat.summary: Russian military intelligence APT28 (Fancy Bear) is actively exploiting CVE-2026-32202 Windows Shell vulnerability in coordinated campaigns against Ukraine and European Union government agencies and military organizations. The group deploys AI-generated PRISMEX backdoor malware for long-term persistent access, command and control, and data exfiltration of classified defense and intelligence information.

threat.ttp: ClickFix initial access, Slopoly backdoor, Interlock encryption
threat.summary: Hive0163 ransomware group is deploying AI-generated Slopoly backdoor malware in targeted attacks against high-value organizations including universities (Texas Tech), healthcare providers (DaVita, Kettering Health), and municipal governments. The group uses ClickFix malvertising campaigns for initial access and demands multi-million dollar ransoms backed by threats to publish patient records and student data.

threat.ttp: Social engineering, MFA bypass, Alphv/BlackCat ransomware
threat.summary: Scattered Spider is one of the most prolific ransomware gangs, specializing in sophisticated social engineering attacks to compromise Fortune 500 companies and financial institutions. The group bypasses multi-factor authentication through employee impersonation and insider recruitment, then deploys Alphv/BlackCat ransomware for maximum impact and ransom extraction in the $5-50 million range.

threat.ttp: Supply chain attacks, Trojanized software, blockchain theft
threat.summary: North Korean state-sponsored Lazarus Group has stolen over $100 million USD in cryptocurrency and digital assets through targeted attacks on cryptocurrency exchanges and DeFi platforms. The group distributes trojanized development tools and cryptocurrency software libraries to compromise exchange infrastructure and steal cryptocurrency directly from hot wallets and customer accounts.

threat.ttp: Spear phishing, malware delivery, lateral movement
threat.summary: FIN7 is the longest-running financially motivated threat group, responsible for an estimated $1+ billion USD in financial fraud and theft. The group specializes in spear phishing campaigns targeting financial services employees, deploying sophisticated banking malware and performing extensive lateral movement to access payment processing systems and customer account databases.

Chinese state-sponsored APT41 blends cybercriminal and espionage operations, targeting healthcare organizations, IT service providers, and telecommunications companies. The group exploits zero-day vulnerabilities and compromises software supply chains to maintain long-term persistent access for intellectual property theft, competitive espionage, and infrastructure intelligence gathering.

LockBit is the largest ransomware group by revenue, operating a Ransomware-as-a-Service platform with a global affiliate network of over 200 active operators. The group has collected billions of dollars in ransom from over 10,000 victim organizations across all sectors including critical infrastructure, healthcare, and government agencies.

threat.ttp: Zero-day exploitation, mass extortion, data theft
threat.summary: Clop ransomware gang exploited CVE-2024-4577 in MOVEit Transfer software to compromise thousands of organizations including healthcare systems, government agencies, and critical infrastructure operators. The group stole sensitive data including patient health records, government contracts, and classified information, demanding multi-million dollar ransoms from each victim.

BlackMatter/Darkside ransomware gang emerged as successor to the famous Darkside group responsible for the Colonial Pipeline attack that disrupted fuel supplies across the US East Coast. The group uses double extortion tactics (encryption + data theft) and distributed denial-of-service attacks to force ransom payments from critical infrastructure operators.

threat.ttp: Malware delivery, banking trojans, lateral movement
threat.summary: Wizard Spider threat group operates and maintains the TrickBot banking malware platform affecting hundreds of thousands of victims globally. The group targets financial institutions with sophisticated banking trojans that monitor online banking sessions, steal credentials, and perform unauthorized wire transfers. TrickBot is also rented to other cybercriminals for initial access to enterprise networks.

news.title: CISA adds 8 exploited flaws to KEV — Cisco, JetBrains, SonicWall deadlines set
news.summary: CISA added 8 actively exploited CVEs to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog including Cisco IOS XE authentication bypass, JetBrains TeamCity pre-auth RCE, and SonicWall SMA 1000 path traversal flaws. Federal civilian agencies have explicit deadlines (FCEB) to patch Cisco by May 9 and JetBrains/SonicWall by May 23, 2026 or face potential network disconnection.

news.title: FBI warns of sharp rise in AI-enabled cargo theft targeting logistics sector
news.summary: The FBI issued an urgent warning to the transportation and logistics industry of a sharp rise in cyber-enabled cargo theft using artificial intelligence tools to optimize targeting and identify high-value shipments. Attackers use AI to predict shipment routes, timing, and value while compromising logistics company networks for real-time visibility. Losses have surged to over $500 million annually.

news.title: Ransomware negotiator sentenced: 4 years for insider attacks on own clients
news.summary: Two former incident response firm employees (Sygnia and DigitalMint) received 4-year federal prison sentences for operating BlackCat ransomware attacks against their own employer's clients while simultaneously serving as official ransomware negotiators. This insider threat enabled them to collect ransom payments and provide attackers with security intelligence about victim defenses.

news.title: CrowdStrike April 2026 Patch Tuesday: 164 CVEs, double March's volume
news.summary: CrowdStrike's April 2026 Patch Tuesday analysis reveals Microsoft released 164 CVEs — double the number from March. The most critical include IKE remote code execution flaw, TCP/IP protocol race condition causing data corruption, and RDP client pre-auth code execution enabling wormable attacks across enterprise networks.

news.title: CISA Director warns of nation-state attacks targeting US critical infrastructure
news.summary: CISA Director Jen Easterly testified to Congress that Russian and Chinese nation-state actors are conducting sophisticated cyber operations against US critical infrastructure including energy grids, water treatment facilities, and transportation systems. The attacks aim to establish persistent access for potential disruption during conflict scenarios and involve exploiting zero-day vulnerabilities.

news.title: National Cyber Strategy 2.0 emphasizes zero trust and quantum readiness
news.summary: The White House released the updated National Cyber Strategy 2.0 prioritizing zero trust architecture adoption, post-quantum cryptography standards for government systems, and increased public-private sector information sharing on threats. Federal agencies have 18 months to transition to zero trust and begin cryptographic agility preparations for quantum computing threats.

news.title: Log4Shell still being actively exploited — unpatched systems under attack
news.summary: Nearly 4 years after the Log4Shell disclosure (CVE-2021-44228), the vulnerability remains one of the most actively exploited flaws globally. Internet-wide scanning shows millions of unpatched Log4j instances still exposed. The flaw's ease of exploitation and critical severity ensure continued attacks against legacy applications and systems unable to upgrade.

news.title: SEC announces new cybersecurity disclosure rules for public companies
news.summary: The SEC finalized new rules requiring publicly traded companies to disclose material cybersecurity incidents and breaches within 4 business days of determining materiality. Stock exchanges must also report cybersecurity incidents affecting trading operations within 2 hours. The rules create significant compliance obligations and financial penalties for non-compliance.

news.title: Cyber insurance premiums spike 40% as claims soar — market faces uncertainty
news.summary: Cyber insurance premiums increased 40% year-over-year as ransomware claims and payout amounts continue climbing. Some major insurers are exiting the cyber insurance market entirely due to unsustainable loss ratios and inability to accurately price cyber risk. This creates an insurance coverage gap for organizations previously relying on cyber policies.

news.title: AI-powered phishing emails bypassing traditional email security at 3x rate
news.summary: Proofpoint report shows AI-generated phishing emails are 3x more likely to bypass traditional email security filters compared to hand-crafted phishing. Spear phishing success rates have risen significantly as attackers use generative AI to create highly personalized and contextually accurate phishing emails targeting specific individuals based on social media and professional profiles.
